headline: Pakistani Consumers Face Additional Power Tariff Burden of Rs1.34/Unit
summary: Power distribution companies and K-Electric consumers are set to bear an additional financial burden of Rs1.34 per unit for the third quarter of 2026 to recover Rs24 billion.
why: Upward tariff adjustments reflect power sector cost recoveries and influence consumer disposable incomes and domestic inflation.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Higher electricity tariffs increase household living expenses and business operational overhead.
